summary.intent: Initialize GSD milestone v2.0 (Metadata and Sharing Refactor) for CipherBox — a brownfield workflow covering scope confirmation, optional research, requirements definition, and roadmap creation continuing phase numbering from v1.1.
summary.outcome: Milestone v2.0 fully initialized on branch `docs/v2.0-metadata-and-sharing-refactor`: PROJECT.md and STATE.md updated, 2 research agents run (Architecture + Pitfalls), SUMMARY.md written, REQUIREMENTS.md with 39 requirements across 8 categories created, and ROADMAP.md with 9 phases (61–69) approved and committed.

repo: `.planning/research/` is tracked in git; only `.planning/tmp/` is gitignored — research artifacts must be committed explicitly.
Direct commits to `main` are forbidden by a branch protection rule; all planning docs require a feature/docs branch and PR flow.
Milestone branch naming convention: `docs/v2.0-{milestone-slug}` (derived from config `milestone_branch_template`).
Phase numbering is continuous across milestones: v1.1 ended at phase 60, so v2.0 starts at phase 61.

Stale v1.1 research files (`STACK.md`, `FEATURES.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `PITFALLS.md`, `SUMMARY.md`) were tracked at `.planning/research/` root; archived to `.planning/research/_v1.1-archive/` before v2.0 research was written.
`gsd_run query agent-skills` returns empty for researcher/synthesizer agents — they carry their own prompts; the call is a no-op but not an error.
Commit signing (GPG via 1Password agent) requires unsandboxed shell access; sandboxed Bash tool blocks it silently.

code.finding: 8-layer blast radius (packages/crypto → core → sdk-core → sdk → apps/api → apps/tee-worker → apps/web → crates/fuse) with 39 requirements across CRYPTO, NODE, READ, ROT, WRITE, TEE, DATA, TEST categories. Three open questions remain in §9.2.

9 phases 61–69 along strict dependency chain; Phase 66 has a TypeORM FK map research flag; Phase 69 has a grant-root algorithm research flag. STATE.md frontmatter correctly set to milestone v2.0 / 9 phases via SDK handler.
39 requirements (not 36 as initially counted by orchestrator — 3+6+5+7+4+7+4+3=39). Traceability verified 39/39 mapped, 0 unmapped.

workflow: The GSD `query commit` helper can produce a false negative: lint-staged reports all ✔ but the commit silently fails when the target branch has push protection. Fall back to direct `git commit` with explicit signing flag.
The synthesizer subagent may be blocked from writing output files in sandboxed execution; the orchestrator must write SUMMARY.md directly from the returned synthesis text.
Requirement count should be verified arithmetically before presenting to user — orchestrator miscounted category totals (36 stated vs 39 actual).

When a design doc is comprehensive and implementation-ready (ADRs ratified, cutover order frozen, test strategy §7.3 defined), skip open-ended questioning and proceed directly to scope confirmation via AskUserQuestion.

friction: Branch protection on `main` blocked the initial commit; had to create `docs/v2.0-metadata-and-sharing-refactor` branch mid-workflow after the first commit attempt silently failed.
`gsd_run query commit` false negative — lint-staged succeeded visually but no commit landed; required switching to direct `git commit -S` for all subsequent commits.
Synthesizer subagent could not write SUMMARY.md to disk (sandboxed permission block); orchestrator had to write the file manually from the returned text, adding an extra step.
Commit signing requires unsandboxed access (1Password SSH agent); each `git commit -S` call triggered a permission prompt.
Initial requirement count presented to user (36) was incorrect — caught only after roadmapper returned the correct count (39), requiring a correction in the approval flow.
open_items: Three open questions from design §9.2 pinned to specific phases: (Q1) co-writer offline handling during rotation — Phase 63; (Q2/Q3) rotation host for pure-web users and write-recipient sub-share authority — Phases 65/68/69.
Two sub-phase research flags before implementation: Phase 66 TypeORM FK cascade map (safe to drop `share_keys`?); Phase 69 grant-root read algorithm (non-trivial traversal).
SEED-001 (Phala TEE on-demand cost reduction) deferred — trigger condition is a future milestone with TEE cost optimization focus.
Tier 3 capability layer / read-side TTL deferred to Future Requirements in REQUIREMENTS.md.
Branch `docs/v2.0-metadata-and-sharing-refactor` needs a PR to merge planning artifacts (PROJECT.md, STATE.md, ROADMAP.md, REQUIREMENTS.md, research/) to `main` before execution phases begin.
